# fewui

> Vue 3 design system: 100 globally registered `ui-*` components, theme packages, Tailwind v4 component styles. Plain JavaScript (Options API) with generated TypeScript declarations.

Rules that apply everywhere: never put appearance classes on a `ui-*` component (use props); `color` is the tone (primary, secondary, success, warning, info, danger) and `variant` is the visual style; visibility is `open` + `update:open`; form controls go inside `ui-form-row`.

## Guide

- [Getting started](https://fewui-kit.pages.dev/kit/getting-started.html): install, CSS setup, plugin registration
- [Theming](https://fewui-kit.pages.dev/kit/theming.html): theme packages, tokens, scoped preview
- [Localization & RTL](https://fewui-kit.pages.dev/kit/localization.html): languages, dates, week start, right-to-left
- [Accessibility](https://fewui-kit.pages.dev/kit/accessibility.html): guarantees and responsibilities
- [TypeScript & tooling](https://fewui-kit.pages.dev/kit/tooling.html): types, components.json, checks
